title: Generative Exaggeration in LLM Social Agents: Consistency, Bias, and Toxicity

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating political discourse by prompting LLM agents with real Twitter users' ideological profiles (Zero-Shot) or tweet histories (Few-Shot), and evaluating the generated replies using an automated stance classifier to measure ideological consistency (Democrat, Republican, or Neutral). The study also quantifies the disproportionate use of partisan emojis and hashtags to identify ideological caricatures and asymmetric exaggeration across the political spectrum.
